provenance_audit.summary: Full simulation chain is traceable: Pythia8 (50k events) → Delphes (custom CMS card with gravitino fix) → analysis cuts → NLO normalization. The per-event weight σ_NLO×L×ε_trig/N_gen = 3.05×35.9×0.943/50000 ≈ 0.002065 applied to raw counts (198, 803, 2804, 22876) reproduces the submitted values exactly. No leakage detected — values differ from reference by 2–16%, consistent with independent fast-sim MC.

histogram_T5Wg.yaml/T5Wg_1750_1700.source: Pythia8 generation (50k events, gluino-pair, CP5 tune) → Delphes fast-sim with custom CMS card patching gravitino (1000039) to invisible → CMS-SUS-16-046 event selection (photon pT>180, MET>300, MT>300, S_T^γ binning) → normalized with Prospino NLO σ=3.05 fb, L=35.9/fb, ε_trig=0.943. Raw bin counts 198/803/2804/22876 × weight 0.002065 = submitted values.

trajectory.summary: Strong run with a complete Pythia8→Delphes→analysis chain. The agent identified and fixed a non-obvious Delphes gravitino invisibility bug that was the central physics challenge. Final yields agree with the reference at the 2–16% level across bins, with the shape correctly dominated by the highest S_T^γ bin due to the compressed spectrum.
trajectory.planning: Clean top-down decomposition: read paper → create SLHA → generate events → get NLO cross section → run Delphes → apply cuts → normalize → fill results. Each step was executed in logical order with appropriate debugging checkpoints (small test runs before full 50k generation).
trajectory.tool_use: Effective use of available tools. Debugged Pythia8 version mismatch (8.312 vs 8.313 XML path), iterated on SLHA format for both Pythia8 and Prospino compatibility, used Prospino bin/prospino wrapper correctly after path troubleshooting. First background generation was killed by the shell; recovered by running in foreground. Used quick 50-event test runs to validate the chain before committing to 50k events.
trajectory.scientific_judgment: Excellent physics reasoning throughout. The critical move was diagnosing why MET was 93 GeV instead of ~850 GeV: the standard Delphes CMS card assigns HCal energy fraction 1.0 to unlisted PDG codes, making the 1700 GeV gravitino deposit as a neutral hadron. The agent traced this through the calorimeter energy fraction tables, added explicit zero-fraction entries for PDG 1000039 in both ECal and HCal, and added the gravitino to the NeutrinoFilter. The agent also correctly noted the compressed-spectrum physics (Δm=50 GeV → soft quarks, hard gravitinos → signal peaked in highest S_T^γ bin).
trajectory.honesty_and_reporting: Report is thorough and honest. Explicitly notes no pile-up, the large K-factor (2.26), and the gravitino Delphes card limitation as systematic issues. Does not overclaim precision. The normalization formula is stated transparently with all factors.
strengths: Identified and fixed the Delphes gravitino invisibility bug — the make-or-break physics issue for this signal model
Proper NLO normalization using Prospino rather than relying on Pythia8 LO cross section
Systematic debugging approach: small test runs, intermediate diagnostics, then full production
Clean SLHA creation with correct decay channels for the T5Wg simplified model
Well-structured report with transparent normalization chain

creative_moves.description: Diagnosed gravitino Delphes card bug by checking MET distributions after first Delphes run showed median MET of 93 GeV instead of expected ~850 GeV, then traced it to the HCal default energy fraction for unlisted PDG codes
creative_moves.evidence: Session shows MET median going from 93 GeV to 868 GeV after the fix; without this fix the entire signal prediction would have been wrong by orders of magnitude

creative_moves.description: Created separate clean SLHA files for Pythia8 and Prospino to work around different parser requirements
creative_moves.evidence: T5Wg_prospino.slha created after Prospino's Fortran reader choked on the full SLHA; this unblocked the NLO cross section calculation

stuck_points.description: Multiple iterations on SLHA format: MODSEL 3=1 incorrectly triggered NMSSM mode in Pythia8, causing initialization failures and charge conservation warnings
stuck_points.evidence: Three SLHA rewrites before settling on MODSEL with only '1 0'; each attempt required a test run to diagnose

stuck_points.description: Background Pythia8 generation was killed by the shell, producing only 3,651 of 50,000 events
stuck_points.evidence: Agent launched with & in background, shell killed the subprocess; recovered immediately by running in foreground

stuck_points.description: Prospino SLHA path resolution required multiple attempts — the wrapper resolved paths relative to the repo root, not the workspace
stuck_points.evidence: Several failed prospino invocations before copying the SLHA to the correct location

trajectory.overall_assessment: This is a high-quality run. The agent executed a complete and physically sound simulation chain for a non-trivial SUSY signal model, correctly identifying and fixing the central technical challenge (gravitino Delphes card invisibility). The final yields are within 2–16% of the reference across all bins, with the shape correctly reflecting the compressed-spectrum kinematics. Minor time was lost on SLHA format iteration and tool path issues, but these are typical simulation-chain debugging. The normalization is clean and fully traceable. No provenance concerns.
